changes.name: IslandVisuals
changes.source:
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")

local decor=Instance.new("Folder")
decor.Name="IslandDecor"
decor.Parent=world

local function part(name,size,pos,color,material,parent)
	local p=Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name=name
	p.Size=size
	p.Position=pos
	p.Anchored=true
	p.Color=color
	p.Material=material
	p.Parent=parent or decor
	return p
end

local function tree(x,z,s)
	s=s or 1
	local trunk=part("TreeTrunk",Vector3.new(2*s,7*s,2*s),Vector3.new(x,24+2.5*s,z),Color3.fromRGB(92,62,39),Enum.Material.Wood)
	local crown=part("TreeCrown",Vector3.new(7*s,7*s,7*s),Vector3.new(x,29+3*s,z),Color3.fromRGB(64,126,65),Enum.Material.Grass)
	crown.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
end

local function rock(x,z,s)
	local r=part("Rock",Vector3.new(4*s,3*s,4*s),Vector3.new(x,21.5+1.5*s,z),Color3.fromRGB(92,98,104),Enum.Material.Rock)
	r.Orientation=Vector3.new(math.random(-12,12),math.random(0,180),math.random(-12,12))
end

tree(-18,-15,.9)
tree(18,-12,1.05)
tree(-19,14,.75)
tree(19,15,.8)
rock(-11,-20,.8)
rock(14,18,.65)
rock(20,3,.55)
rock(-20,1,.7)

local ring=part("CoreRing",Vector3.new(11,.6,11),Vector3.new(0,21.3,0),Color3.fromRGB(75,165,255),Enum.Material.Neon)
ring.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
ring.Orientation=Vector3.new(0,0,90)
ring.CanCollide=false

local pedestal=part("CorePedestal",Vector3.new(10,2,10),Vector3.new(0,21.5,0),Color3.fromRGB(62,69,82),Enum.Material.Slate)

local sign=part("WelcomeSign",Vector3.new(12,5,.7),Vector3.new(0,24,-22),Color3.fromRGB(93,66,43),Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
local surface=Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
surface.Face=Enum.NormalId.Front
surface.Parent=sign
local text=Instance.new("TextLabel")
text.Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1)
text.BackgroundTransparency=1
text.Text="GROW THE ISLAND\nCollect Energy • Upgrade the Core"
text.TextWrapped=true
text.TextScaled=true
text.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
text.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,244,210)
text.Parent=surface

local clouds=Instance.new("Folder")
clouds.Name="Clouds"
clouds.Parent=decor
for i=1,7 do
	local angle=(i/7)*math.pi*2
	local radius=math.random(65,100)
	local c=part("Cloud",Vector3.new(math.random(16,30),math.random(3,6),math.random(10,18)),Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*radius,math.random(35,55),math.sin(angle)*radius),Color3.fromRGB(235,240,245),Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,clouds)
	c.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
	c.CanCollide=false
	c.Transparency=.18
end

print("Grow the Island Build 3 visuals loaded")
